title: うらやましいとおもった (Urayamashii to Omotta)
description: When Sota's best friend gets a new bicycle — exactly the kind Sota has always wanted — Sota feels a strange, uncomfortable feeling he doesn't understand. With his grandmother's help, he learns to name the feeling as jealousy and discovers that envy is not something shameful, but a signal pointing toward what we care about.
author: オリジナル
